items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: he could have dedicated it to something. But he called it “Sound Pieces,” just like Samuel Barber called that beautiful piece “Adagio for Strings.”

ctx.x: No. And if the music is tough you’ve got to woodshed that stuff just like anybody else does.

Okay. Now I think I lost my question. Actually this is something I think about a lot. What does music mean? And when he called it “Sound Pieces” he could have called it something descriptive, he could have dedicated it to something. But he called it “Sound Pieces,” just like Samuel Barber called that beautiful piece “Adagio for Strings.”
